iCloudPhotos.apple_id-tips: Apple ID of the account that owns the photo library.
iCloudPhotos.password-tips: Only needed to sign in. After the first success the session is saved and this can be left as is.
iCloudPhotos.two_factor_code-tips: Step 2: save once with Apple ID + password, Apple then sends a 6-digit code to your trusted device; type it here and save again. Leave empty afterwards.
iCloudPhotos.china-tips: Tick if the Apple ID's region is China mainland (icloud.com.cn).
iCloudPhotos.proxy-tips: Proxy for the iCloud connection, e.g. socks5h://host:1080. Empty keeps the container's proxy settings.
iCloudPhotos.show_smart_albums-tips: Also list smart albums (Favorites, Videos, ...) next to your own albums.
iCloudPhotos.show_shared-tips: Show a read-only "Shared Albums" folder in the root (includes albums shared with you). The first open reads from iCloud; refresh after a few seconds.
iCloudPhotos.write_existing-tips: Off (default): only albums and photos created through this storage can be changed. On: you can also rename, move and archive your existing albums and photos. Live Photos stay read-only either way; delete always archives.
iCloudPhotos.read_only-tips: Refuse every write (upload, delete, rename, move, copy). Overrides the option above.
iCloudPhotos.data_dir-tips: Where the session and index are kept. Default data/icloud-photos.

PixCake Cloud.token-tips: Login JWT, about 345 characters starting with eyJ. Fill this, or leave it empty and fill Token V2 + Hardware UUID instead.
PixCake Cloud.token_v2-tips: Hex ciphertext from the macOS client database: sqlite3 "$HOME/Library/Application Support/PixCake-qt_pro/db/base.db" "SELECT tokenV2 FROM user ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT 1;". Not needed if Token is filled.
PixCake Cloud.hardware_uuid-tips: UUID of the Mac that produced Token V2 (system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep UUID). Not needed if Token is filled.
PixCake Cloud.support_app_id-tips: Leave as 1; the official client always uses 1.
PixCake Cloud.api_base-tips: Official endpoint by default. Only change it for a reverse proxy; the official API is in mainland China and is slow from overseas.
PixCake Cloud.show_team-tips: Also list projects you only take part in as a team member.
PixCake Cloud.root_folder_id-tips: Fill a project ID to mount only that project; leave empty to mount all projects.
PixCake Cloud.read_only-tips: Refuse every write: create project, upload, delete.

Immich.api_key-tips: Account Settings → API Keys. OpenList sends it as x-api-key and never puts it in download URLs.
Immich.show_type-tips: root_only_album: albums as folders (default, same as 一刻/iCloud). root: albums plus an All folder. root_only_file: every asset at the root.
Immich.album_id-tips: Pin this storage to one album UUID. Empty lists all albums.
Immich.hide_live_video-tips: Immich stores a Live Photo as a still plus a .MOV. On (default): only the still is listed. Download the still for the photo; the video stays in Immich.
Immich.read_only-tips: Refuse upload, mkdir, delete, rename, copy, move.
Immich.device_id-tips: Sent with uploads. Immich uses deviceId + deviceAssetId to detect duplicates. Default openlist.

FnOSPhoto.address-tips: fnOS NAS address (scheme + port), e.g. https://192.168.1.10:5667; reverse-proxy subpath supported.
FnOSPhoto.username-tips: fnOS login username; required unless AccessToken is provided.
FnOSPhoto.password-tips: fnOS login password. Accounts with 2FA cannot log in automatically; paste the web AccessToken instead.
FnOSPhoto.access_token-tips: Optional: the AccessToken header from any /p/api request in the fnOS web UI (F12). Skips password login when set.
FnOSPhoto.show_shared-tips: Show albums shared to this account in the root directory.
FnOSPhoto.show_all-tips: Show an All Photos virtual folder in the root (all photos and videos by date taken, not grouped by album).
FnOSPhoto.skip_verify-tips: fnOS uses a self-signed certificate by default; keep this on.

iCloudPhotos.alert: Sign-in takes two saves: Apple ID + password first, then the 6-digit 2FA code. Writes only touch albums created here; deleting archives a photo instead of removing it; Live Photos are read-only.

PixCake Cloud.alert: Reverse-engineered client API, not an official one. Paste a new token when it expires.

Immich.alert: Albums are folders. Upload into an album (or All) sends the original to Immich. Downloads proxy through OpenList so the API key stays here. Live Photo stills list as one file; the paired video is hidden by default.

FnOSPhoto.alert: Read-only mount structured by album: the root lists your albums, and inside an album are its photos and videos. Media links need the AccessToken header, so the driver is proxy-only — no manual settings required.
